policies.name: case_time_logs_insert_owner_rls
policies.with_check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text, 'lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text, 'staff'::text]))))) AND (created_by_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NULL))

policies.name: case_time_logs_select_owner_rls
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text]))))) OR ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text, 'staff'::text]))))) AND ((created_by_user_id = auth.uid()) OR (created_by_email = (auth.jwt() ->> 'email'::text)))))

policies.name: case_time_logs_update_admin_partner_all_rls
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text])))))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'partner'::text])))))

policies.name: case_time_logs_update_own_rls
policies.using:
((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.active = true) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['lawyer'::text, 'assistant_lawyer'::text, 'staff'::text]))))) AND ((created_by_user_id = auth.uid()) OR (created_by_email = (auth.jwt() ->> 'email'::text))))
policies.with_check: ((created_by_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_by IS NULL))

can_create_case().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_create_case()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_profiles up
    WHERE up.id = auth.uid() AND up.active IS TRUE AND up.must_change_password IS FALSE
      AND up.role IN ('admin','partner','lawyer'));
$function$

can_view_case_data().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_case_data()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_profiles up
    where up.id = auth.uid()
      and up.active = true
      and up.role in (
        'admin',
        'partner',
        'lawyer',
        'assistant_lawyer',
        'staff',
        'viewer'
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.case097_session_ready()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_profiles p
    WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.active IS TRUE AND p.must_change_password IS FALSE);
$function$

case097_process_writer().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.case097_process_writer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.case097_session_ready() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_profiles p
    WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.role IN ('admin','partner','lawyer','assistant_lawyer'));
$function$

  select exists (

    from public.user_profiles up
    where up.id = auth.uid()
      and up.active = true
      and (
        up.role in ('admin', 'partner')
        or up.financial_access = true

  );
$function$
